positions.title: High Performance Computing Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineering for high performance computing systems using C, MPI, SHMEM and Unified Parallel C (UPC).

Ported legacy software to the latest HPC platforms and exploited data parallelism where appropriate to maximize performance.

Release and configuration manager for several small sized software projects.

Participated in all phases of the acquisition and testing process for multiple HPC systems from a variety of vendors.  This includes requirements definition and verification, benchmarking, and stress testing.

positions.title: Graduate Student, Computer Science
positions.description: My main research interests were natural language processing and programming languages.

positions.title: Senior Instructor of Computer Science
positions.description: I taught five undergraduate computer science courses over four semesters: Operating Systems, Theory of Computing, Systems Programming, Data Structures, and Programming for Engineers.

positions.title: Division Officer
positions.description: Held positions as the Damage Control Assistant, Radiological Controls Assistant and Reactor Control Assistant.

honors.title: Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal
